title: System Configuration
description: System-wide paths, environment, and global flags

path.description: Path to the aico-studio workspace (absolute or relative to the AICO repo root)

data_root.description: Root directory for all data storage

self_healing.description: Autonomous remediation options triggered by IssueDetectionService.

enabled.description: Enable autonomous self-healing flow. Disabled by default.

run_immediately.description: If true, execute generated plans immediately after intention set update.

allow_side_effects.description: If false, self-healing runs remediation skills in dry-run mode.

max_steps_per_goal.description: Safety bound for how many steps may be executed per goal in a single cycle.

simulation.description: Deterministic simulated issues for end-to-end testing of self-healing. Must be explicitly enabled.

enabled.description: If true, inject a clearly-marked simulated issue into the detection cycle.

issue_id.description: Stable simulated issue_id used for deterministic end-to-end tests.

persist_issue.description: If true, persist the simulated issue as a SystemIssue record in the database.
